ABTestHero.useWhen: Top-of-page hero with heading, description, one CTA and an image, plus an Experiment Key and a list of A/B Test Hero Item variants. Use only when the page is running an A/B experiment on the hero.
ABTestHero.avoidWhen: No experiment is running: use Hero for a plain text-and-image hero. For a full-width background image or gradient hero use BackgroundHero. For audience-based (not experiment-based) variants use PersonalizedBackgroundHero.

AnnouncementBar.useWhen: A thin site-wide message bar with one line of text, an optional link, a dismissible toggle and start/end dates. Use for time-boxed notices such as a launch, event or outage.
AnnouncementBar.avoidWhen: The message needs a heading, description and buttons as a full-width section: use CTABanner. For capturing email addresses use NewsletterSignup. Not for permanent page content.

alternatives.when: full section with heading and buttons

BackgroundHero.useWhen: Hero with heading, description and up to two CTAs over a color gradient or a background image. It renders under the menu when placed at the top, or as a normal section elsewhere.
BackgroundHero.avoidWhen: You want text on one side and a separate image on the other: use Hero. For audience-specific variants use PersonalizedBackgroundHero; for an A/B experiment use ABTestHero. For a closing call-to-action band use CTABanner.

alternatives.when: closing CTA band, not an opener

CTABanner.useWhen: A full-width call-to-action band with heading, description, a primary and a secondary button, and a background style or image. Use to push one action, usually near the end of a page.
CTABanner.avoidWhen: You need a page opener: use BackgroundHero or Hero. A one-line site notice is AnnouncementBar. Email capture is NewsletterSignup; a contact form is ContactUs.

BentoSection.useWhen: A sub-heading and heading above a set of Bento Card items (eyebrow, title, description, graphic). Use to showcase product screenshots or graphics in a mosaic layout.
BentoSection.avoidWhen: The items are short icon-plus-text features: use FeatureGrid. For a rotating set of full slides use carousel. For a plain image grid with captions use Gallery.

carousel.useWhen: A subheading and heading above a rotating set of Carousel Slides, each with heading, description, background image and CTA. Use for several featured items that share one slot.
carousel.avoidWhen: All items should be visible at once: use FeatureGrid, BentoSection or Gallery. Customer quotes belong in Testimonials. A single page-opening hero is Hero or BackgroundHero.

CompanyStats.useWhen: A stats section with a section title, heading, description and optional background image above a list of Stat items. Use for an 'about us' or credibility section that needs a titled, image-backed look.
CompanyStats.avoidWhen: You want a simple centered heading above one row of stat tiles with no section title or background image: use StatsStrip. Pricing numbers belong in PricingCards.

alternatives.when: plain single row of stat tiles

ComparisonTable.useWhen: A heading with a table: comma-style column names plus Comparison Row items (feature, values, note). Use to compare options, plans or competitors feature by feature.
ComparisonTable.avoidWhen: You are listing plans with prices and buy buttons: use PricingCards. A features-by-plan matrix driven by JSON is PricingTable. For non-tabular benefit lists use FeatureGrid.

ContactUs.useWhen: A contact form with heading, description, submit URL, success/error/loading messages, and office address, phone and email. Use on contact or sales-enquiry pages.
ContactUs.avoidWhen: You only need an email address for a mailing list: use NewsletterSignup. For a closing button-based call to action use CTABanner.

FeatureGrid.useWhen: A heading and subheading above a grid of Feature Items (title, description, icon, optional link), with a column-count choice. Use for product features or benefits.
FeatureGrid.avoidWhen: Items are numbered stages in order: use Steps. Items are large screenshots or graphics: use BentoSection. Customer quotes are Testimonials; stats are StatsStrip.

Header.useWhen: A plain section heading with optional subheading and description, no image or buttons. Use to introduce or title a block of content lower on the page.
Header.avoidWhen: You need a page-opening hero with image or CTA: use Hero or BackgroundHero. Many components already carry their own heading, so don't add Header above them. It is not the site navigation header.

Hero.useWhen: Standard page hero with heading, description, one CTA and an image placed left or right. Use for most page openers.
Hero.avoidWhen: You want text over a full-width gradient or image: use BackgroundHero. For audience-personalized openers use PersonalizedBackgroundHero; for A/B testing use ABTestHero. For a mid-page image-and-text block use MediaSplit.

alternatives.when: text over background image or gradient

MediaSplit.useWhen: A two-column block: eyebrow, heading, rich-text body and optional button beside an image on the left or right. Use for mid-page explanations that need formatted text.
MediaSplit.avoidWhen: It is the page opener: use Hero. Several parallel items belong in FeatureGrid or Steps. Free-form editorial content with no image layout fits RichTextArea better.

Gallery.useWhen: A heading and a grid of Gallery Images with captions, with a layout choice. Use for photos, screenshots or event pictures where the images themselves are the content.
Gallery.avoidWhen: Each card needs a title and description: use BentoSection. Customer or partner logos are LogoStrip. Rotating full slides are carousel.

LogoStrip.useWhen: A row of customer or partner logos (Logo Items) with a short CTA description and link. Use as social proof under a hero or before a CTA.
LogoStrip.avoidWhen: You want quotes from customers: use Testimonials. Logos that should change by audience need PersonalizedLogoStrip, which is outside this set. General images go in Gallery.

PersonalizedBackgroundHero.useWhen: Hero with heading, description, two CTAs and a gradient or background image, plus Personalized Hero Items that swap content for different audiences. Use when the opener must change by visitor segment.
PersonalizedBackgroundHero.avoidWhen: One message for everyone: use BackgroundHero or Hero. Variants meant for an A/B experiment, not audiences, belong in ABTestHero.

PricingCards.useWhen: A title and subtitle above Pricing Tier cards (name, monthly price, currency, highlights, CTA button, region). Use to present plans side by side with a button per plan.
PricingCards.avoidWhen: You need a feature-by-plan matrix fed by JSON: use PricingTable. A general side-by-side comparison with no prices or buttons is ComparisonTable.

PricingTable.useWhen: A title and subtitle above a features table built from a Features JSON text field. Use only when you already have the JSON structure for plan features.
PricingTable.avoidWhen: You are building plans from content items: use PricingCards. A hand-edited comparison of features with rows as content is ComparisonTable. Do not guess JSON structure.

Steps.useWhen: A heading above numbered Step items (title, description). Use for how-it-works, onboarding or process sequences where order matters.
Steps.avoidWhen: Items are unordered benefits: use FeatureGrid. Items need images: use BentoSection. For a comparison across options use ComparisonTable.

NewsletterSignup.useWhen: An email signup form with heading, description, button text, mailing list ID, consent text and success message. Use to grow a mailing list.
NewsletterSignup.avoidWhen: You need a contact or enquiry form with address, phone and email details: use ContactUs. A button-only call to action is CTABanner.

StatsStrip.useWhen: A centered heading and description above a single row of Stat tiles (value and label). Use for a quick row of key numbers.
StatsStrip.avoidWhen: You need a section title and a background image around the stats: use CompanyStats. Pricing or plan details belong in PricingCards.

Testimonial.useWhen: A single customer quote: it links to one Testimonial Item (name, title, quote, image). Use to feature one quote prominently within a page.
Testimonial.avoidWhen: You want several quotes with a heading and CTA: use Testimonials. Logos as social proof are LogoStrip. Do not use it to show a list.

Testimonials.useWhen: A subheading and heading above a list of selected Testimonial Items, with an optional CTA link. Use when showing multiple customer quotes together.
Testimonials.avoidWhen: Only one quote is needed: use Testimonial. Rotating non-quote slides are carousel; customer logos are LogoStrip.

BentoCard.useWhen: One card inside a Bento Section: eyebrow, title, description and a graphic. Create one per card and link them from BentoSection.
BentoCard.avoidWhen: The item is a feature with an icon and link: use FeatureItem. A captioned picture only is GalleryImage. A slide with a CTA is carouselSlide.

alternatives.when: icon, text and link for Feature Grid

carouselSlide.useWhen: One slide in a Carousel: heading, description, background image, call-to-action link and optional CTA text override. Link from the Carousel component.
carouselSlide.avoidWhen: The item feeds a Bento Section (BentoCard), a Feature Grid (FeatureItem) or an image gallery (GalleryImage).

ComparisonRow.useWhen: One row of a Comparison Table: a feature name, its values for each column, and a note. Values must line up with the table's column names.
ComparisonRow.avoidWhen: The content is a pricing plan (PricingTier) or an ordered process step (StepItem). A feature with icon and description is FeatureItem.

FeatureItem.useWhen: One item in a Feature Grid: title, description, icon and optional link.
FeatureItem.avoidWhen: The card needs a large graphic and eyebrow for a Bento Section (BentoCard). A numbered process step is StepItem; a comparison row is ComparisonRow.

GalleryImage.useWhen: One image with a caption for the Gallery component.
GalleryImage.avoidWhen: The image needs a title, description or CTA: use BentoCard or carouselSlide. A person's quote with a photo is TestimonialItem.

Post.useWhen: A blog post or article: heading, slug, date, category, tags, author, rich-text content and image. Use for every editorial article shown in post listings and on post detail pages.
Post.avoidWhen: The content is a testimonial quote (TestimonialItem) or short supporting copy inside a page component. Static pages belong in page components, not Post.

PricingTier.useWhen: One pricing plan: region, name, description, monthly price, currency, CTA button and highlights. Link from the Pricing Cards component.
PricingTier.avoidWhen: The row compares features across options (ComparisonRow), or the item is a feature without a price (FeatureItem).

StepItem.useWhen: One numbered step in the Steps component: a title and description.
StepItem.avoidWhen: The item is an unordered feature with icon and link (FeatureItem), or a card with a graphic (BentoCard).

TestimonialItem.useWhen: One customer quote: name, job title, quote text and photo. Reference it from the Testimonial or Testimonials components.
TestimonialItem.avoidWhen: The item is a captioned picture (GalleryImage) or a carousel slide (carouselSlide). Long editorial content is Post.
